title: Cognitive Dissonance
coreMove: Use Cognitive Dissonance as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Cognitive Dissonance as a specific decision error around cognitive dissonance, contradiction, excuse. Traceable support includes Scott Plous, The Psychology.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Cognitive Dissonance as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: use cognitive dissonance as the warning label, then make the specific correction before the choice moves forward.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Cognitive Dissonance.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Cognitive Dissonance sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
No example may skip the specific mechanics of Cognitive Dissonance.
